title: Bogart sells Israeli subsidiary to its main shareholder
summary: The French Bogart Group (Jacques Bogart, Ted Lapidus, Carven, April, DI Drugstores, HC Parfümerie, etc.) has announced the sale of 100% of its Israeli subsidiary, April Cosmetics and Perfumes Store Chain Ltd, to April Holding D.K. Ltd., a company owned by Bogart Chairman and CEO and majority shareholder David Konckier. Approved by the board of directors on October 12, 2026, the transaction is intended to strengthen the group's financial position and improve resource allocation.
